fact: The Auditor General reports government introduced IRAS in FY2019/20 and E-Logrev in FY2016/17 against poor record-keeping and payment tracking, and the 2017 local revenue manual requires Enumeration and Registration Committees to identify and list taxpayers, which at Mpigi District were non-functional.
title: Report of the Auditor General on Mpigi District Local Government for the audit year ended December 2025
